ジロル-sensei. Thank you for looking at this request.
I think your clothing designs are really unique and very cute, especially the vibrant pops of color you add in the clothes, and the unique appeal designs too! (o´▽`o)

I would humbly like to ask for outfit designs for my VTuber.
I'll leave a lot of the clothing design up to you, but my main points would be girly, fashionista, dreamy, and pretty please. I like the ideas of hime gyaru, mori kei, restaurant, and Japanese traditional like miko clothes, but whatever you feel happy and fun while designing.

My Vtuber, MinxMilk, is a very comfortable, soft, and kind girl.
Her heart is really for being a peace maker and very fluffy feeling.
MinxMilk is a milk maiden and a shrine maiden: traveling in dreams, different dimensions, and real life to exorcise evil and give blessings to all those in need. MinxMilk is really good at reiki and healing others as well too.

Her family is originally humble farm folk, but her powers awakened slowly over time, and since then she has been perfecting what she can do.
She sells yummy foods and drinks like pearl milktea and ice cream crepes.
Her favorite animals are bunnies, even though she is like a minks. But she loves all animals, especially fluffy ones, since she understands animals the best.
She loves video games, arts and crafts, manga/anime, traveling, gardening, and cooking.

She's about 160cm tall. With black/white hair, and red/blue eyes.
Usually I have her hair in giant huge ponytails with ribbons, but please go right ahead and feel as creative as you would like with different designs.
But I highly request the hair be luscious, thick, and suitable for a dreamy girl. Even more bigger than the references, please.
She's also kind of sexy, but in a cute and fun way. She likes to tease, but does her best to not be judgemental.
